notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Triskelion lifelink.
description:
Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Triskelion's lifelink ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat from step 2.
